findings.title: S3 bucket allows public read access
findings.description: Bucket 'prod-app-logs-2024' grants READ or FULL_CONTROL to the AllUsers group. Any object in this bucket can be read anonymously over the internet.
findings.remediation: Remove public READ grants unless the bucket is intentionally hosting public content (e.g. a static website). Enable S3 Block Public Access.

compliance.control_title: Ensure S3 buckets are not publicly accessible

findings.title: S3 bucket does not enforce server-side encryption
findings.description: Bucket 'prod-app-logs-2024' has no default server-side encryption configuration (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS).
findings.remediation: Enable default encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) on the bucket via PutBucketEncryption. Prefer SSE-KMS for sensitive data.

compliance.control_title: Ensure S3 buckets have server-side encryption enabled

findings.title: S3 bucket versioning is disabled
findings.description: Bucket 'prod-app-logs-2024' does not have versioning enabled, increasing risk of unrecoverable data loss from accidental deletion or overwrite.
findings.remediation: Enable versioning via PutBucketVersioning, and consider adding an MFA Delete requirement for critical buckets.

compliance.control_title: Ensure S3 bucket versioning is enabled

findings.title: S3 bucket access logging is disabled
findings.description: Bucket 'prod-app-logs-2024' does not have server access logging enabled, limiting forensic visibility into who accessed objects.
findings.remediation: Enable S3 server access logging or, preferably, use CloudTrail S3 data events for more detailed and queryable audit logs.

compliance.control_title: Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled

findings.title: S3 Block Public Access is not fully enabled
findings.description: Bucket 'prod-app-logs-2024' does not have all four S3 Block Public Access settings enabled, leaving a gap that could allow future accidental exposure.
findings.remediation: Enable all four Block Public Access settings at the bucket level (and ideally at the account level as a guardrail).

compliance.control_title: Ensure S3 Block Public Access is enabled at the bucket level

findings.title: IAM access key exceeds rotation policy
findings.description: Access key AKIAEXAMPLE00000001 for user 'svc-ci-deploy' is 412 days old, exceeding the 90-day rotation window.
findings.remediation: Rotate the access key and, where possible, replace long-lived keys with short-lived credentials via IAM roles / STS / OIDC federation.

compliance.control_title: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less

findings.title: Highly privileged policy attached directly to IAM user
findings.description: User 'svc-ci-deploy' has the 'AdministratorAccess' managed policy attached directly, rather than being granted broad access via a role.
findings.remediation: Attach broad-privilege policies to IAM roles/groups instead of individual users, and apply least-privilege, scoped policies per user.

compliance.control_title: Ensure IAM policies with full administrative privileges are not attached to users directly

findings.title: Highly privileged policy attached directly to IAM user
findings.description: User 'jsmith' has the 'PowerUserAccess' managed policy attached directly, rather than being granted broad access via a role.
findings.remediation: Attach broad-privilege policies to IAM roles/groups instead of individual users, and apply least-privilege, scoped policies per user.

compliance.control_title: Ensure IAM policies with full administrative privileges are not attached to users directly

findings.title: IAM user has console access without MFA
findings.description: User 'root-break-glass' can sign in to the AWS Console with a password but does not have a multi-factor authentication device registered.
findings.remediation: Require and enforce MFA enrollment for every IAM user with console access; consider an IAM policy that denies actions when MFA is absent.

compliance.control_title: Ensure MFA is enabled for all IAM users with a console password

findings.title: IAM access key exceeds rotation policy
findings.description: Access key AKIAEXAMPLE00000003 for user 'legacy-app-user' is 730 days old, exceeding the 90-day rotation window.
findings.remediation: Rotate the access key and, where possible, replace long-lived keys with short-lived credentials via IAM roles / STS / OIDC federation.

compliance.control_title: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less

findings.title: IAM access key unused for an extended period
findings.description: Access key AKIAEXAMPLE00000003 for user 'legacy-app-user' has not been used in 220 days.
findings.remediation: Deactivate or delete access keys that are no longer in active use to reduce the credential attack surface.

compliance.control_title: Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or more are disabled

findings.title: Root account does not have MFA enabled
findings.description: The AWS account root user does not have a multi-factor authentication device configured. The root user has unrestricted access to every resource in the account.
findings.remediation: Enable a hardware or virtual MFA device on the root user immediately, and avoid using the root user for daily tasks.

compliance.control_title: Ensure MFA is enabled for the root user

findings.title: Account password policy does not meet security baseline
findings.description: The IAM account password policy does not require a sufficiently long/complex password or does not prevent password reuse.
findings.remediation: Set minimum length to 14+, require symbols and numbers, and set password reuse prevention to at least 5.

compliance.control_title: Ensure IAM password policy requires strong passwords

findings.title: Security group exposes SSH (port 22) to the internet
findings.description: Security group 'web-prod-sg' (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f60001) allows inbound SSH traffic on port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0.
findings.remediation: Restrict port 22 ingress to specific known IP ranges (e.g. office/VPN CIDRs) or remove the rule and use a bastion/SSM Session Manager / VPN for administrative access.

compliance.control_title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22

findings.title: Security group exposes MySQL (port 3306) to the internet
findings.description: Security group 'db-prod-sg' (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f60002) allows inbound MySQL traffic on port 3306 from 0.0.0.0/0.
findings.remediation: Restrict port 3306 ingress to specific known IP ranges (e.g. office/VPN CIDRs) or remove the rule and use a bastion/SSM Session Manager / VPN for administrative access.

compliance.control_title: Ensure no security groups allow unrestricted ingress to database ports

findings.title: Security group exposes RDP (port 3389) to the internet
findings.description: Security group 'rdp-admin-sg' (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f60004) allows inbound RDP traffic on port 3389 from 0.0.0.0/0.
findings.remediation: Restrict port 3389 ingress to specific known IP ranges (e.g. office/VPN CIDRs) or remove the rule and use a bastion/SSM Session Manager / VPN for administrative access.

compliance.control_title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 3389

findings.title: Security group allows unrestricted ingress on all ports/protocols
findings.description: Security group 'all-traffic-legacy' (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f60005) allows inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports and protocols.
findings.remediation: Restrict ingress rules to specific, required ports and known source CIDR ranges. Never allow all-ports/all-protocols from the internet.

compliance.control_title: Ensure no security groups allow unrestricted ingress to all ports/protocols

findings.title: RDS instance is publicly accessible
findings.description: Database instance 'db-prod-main' (mysql) has a public endpoint and can be reached directly from the internet.
findings.remediation: Set PubliclyAccessible to false and place the instance in a private subnet. Access it through a bastion host, VPN, or application tier only.

compliance.control_title: Ensure RDS instances are not publicly accessible

findings.title: RDS instance storage is not encrypted
findings.description: Database instance 'db-prod-main' does not have storage encryption (KMS) enabled, exposing data at rest.
findings.remediation: Enable storage encryption. Existing unencrypted instances typically require a snapshot-and-restore into a new encrypted instance.

compliance.control_title: Ensure RDS instance encryption is enabled

findings.title: RDS automated backups are disabled
findings.description: Database instance 'db-prod-main' has a backup retention period of 0 days, meaning automated backups are effectively disabled.
findings.remediation: Set the backup retention period to at least 7 days (30+ for production/critical systems) and validate restore procedures periodically.

compliance.control_title: Ensure RDS automated backups are enabled

findings.title: RDS deletion protection is disabled
findings.description: Database instance 'db-prod-main' does not have deletion protection enabled, allowing accidental or malicious deletion.
findings.remediation: Enable deletion protection for all production database instances.

compliance.control_title: Ensure RDS deletion protection is enabled for production databases

findings.title: RDS deletion protection is disabled
findings.description: Database instance 'db-staging-replica' does not have deletion protection enabled, allowing accidental or malicious deletion.
findings.remediation: Enable deletion protection for all production database instances.

compliance.control_title: Ensure RDS deletion protection is enabled for production databases

findings.title: CloudTrail trail is not multi-region
findings.description: Trail 'management-events-trail' only records events in its home region, creating blind spots for activity in other AWS regions.
findings.remediation: Enable 'multi-region trail' so API activity is captured account-wide, including regions you don't normally use.

compliance.control_title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions

findings.title: CloudTrail logs are not encrypted with KMS
findings.description: Trail 'management-events-trail' delivers logs to S3 without SSE-KMS encryption configured.
findings.remediation: Configure the trail to use SSE-KMS encryption with a dedicated CMK, and restrict key usage via a tightly scoped key policy.

compliance.control_title: Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted using KMS

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.description: Volume 'vol-0a1111aaa2222bbb3' does not have encryption enabled, exposing data at rest if the underlying disk is ever improperly decommissioned or accessed.
findings.remediation: Enable EBS encryption by default at the account/region level, and migrate existing unencrypted volumes via snapshot-copy-with-encryption.

compliance.control_title: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.description: Volume 'vol-0c3333ccc4444ddd5' does not have encryption enabled, exposing data at rest if the underlying disk is ever improperly decommissioned or accessed.
findings.remediation: Enable EBS encryption by default at the account/region level, and migrate existing unencrypted volumes via snapshot-copy-with-encryption.

compliance.control_title: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled
